description: Pedestrian fall detected by UAV and response chain

initial_state.semantic_role: long-lived UAV inspect view replacing high overview
visible facility context required by low-altitude event-chain contract

validation_rules.description: ped_fall_l4_7_v2 is declared before event_script references it in L4-7_v2
uav_detect_l4_7_v2 is declared before event_script references it in L4-7_v2
Episode must match the low-altitude semantic event-chain contract exactly after generation
UAV waypoints are repaired for building clearance; corridor scene entities are capped by the exact episode logical-sidecar contract
Mission/observer UAV routes must pass through the semantic capture boundary; pads may remain outside unless the pad policy says otherwise
Ambulance source waypoints stay on one physical lane and reach a curbside standoff distance from the fallen pedestrian
Episode location is assigned from the city main-road spatial grid; traffic incidents bind to SUMO incident anchors while nontraffic EPI avoid incident grids
Targeted truth regeneration uses the explicit ROI contract and does not reassign a spatial grid cell
